class WeightedDSU:
    def __init__(self, n={{n}}):
        self.p = list(range(n))
        self.w = [0]*n
    def find(self, x):
        if self.p[x] == x: return x
        r = self.find(self.p[x])
        self.w[x] += self.w[self.p[x]]
        self.p[x] = r
        return r
    def union(self, a, b, diff):
        ra, rb = self.find(a), self.find(b)
        if ra == rb: return self.w[a] - self.w[b] == diff
        self.p[ra] = rb
        self.w[ra] = self.w[b] + diff - self.w[a]
        return True
